q1.explanationZh: 女孩说这双鞋原价 75.50 英镑，她在打折时只花了 47.99 英镑（forty-seven ninety-nine）就买到了。B 错：51.75 英镑是男孩哥哥那双鞋的价格；C 错：75.50 英镑是原价。

q2.explanationZh: 女孩夸花很漂亮，男孩说奶奶很喜欢这些花，他要把那张照片打印出来给奶奶挂在墙上。B 错：海滩照片是女孩夸的；C 错：城堡照片是男孩自己最喜欢的。

q3.explanationZh: 他们现在在购物中心，要先回家吃午饭，妈妈让他们饭后去骑自行车，男孩说骑完车再玩游戏，所以下午先去骑车。A 错：玩棋盘游戏要等骑车以后；B 错：购物是他们现在（午饭前）在做的事。

q4.explanationZh: 女孩说家里没有蘑菇了，所以用番茄配洋葱（tomatoes with the onion）。A 错：蘑菇加洋葱是男孩喜欢的；B 错：番茄加蘑菇是男孩妈妈的做法。

q5.explanationZh: 男孩说妹妹是长头发，但头发是深色的；女孩说她平时戴眼镜，男孩也说妹妹不戴眼镜就看不清，所以是深色长发、戴眼镜的女孩。A 错：妹妹不是金色头发；C 错：妹妹戴眼镜。

q6.explanationZh: Jake 说地址是 51 号 Sherby Street，还把街名拼了出来：S-H-E-R-B-Y。

q7.explanationZh: Jake 说平时可以坐火车去他家，但离他家最近的火车站现在关闭了，所以要坐有轨电车（tram）。train 是干扰项。

q8.explanationZh: Jake 让朋友一点三刻（quarter to two）到，也就是 1:45；half past four（4:30）是 Jake 要出门、朋友也得离开的时间。

q9.explanationZh: Jake 请朋友把那天天冷时借走的手套（gloves）还给他；帽子（hat）朋友可以留着，所以不是 hat。

q10.explanationZh: Jake 说妈妈的电话号码是 05568 129437，要把所有数字按顺序写对。

q11.explanationZh: Emma 的妈妈要去看 Emma 的表亲，所以他们和住在隔壁的 Annie 一起去，Annie 就是 Emma 的邻居（neighbour）。A 错：妈妈没空；C 错：cousin 是妈妈要去看望的人。

q12.explanationZh: Emma 说他们会在 quarter to eleven（10:45）到 Jamie 家接他。A 错：10:15 是她钢琴课结束的时间；B 错：10:30 是她最早能出门的时间。

q13.explanationZh: Emma 跳舞穿的裙子是向朋友借的，她要买项链和耳环（necklace and earrings）来搭配，也就是首饰（jewellery）。B 错：裙子是借的，不用买；C 错：玩具是 Jamie 要给弟弟买的。

q14.explanationZh: Jamie 说市场上的旧电脑游戏在别的地方买不到，所以很特别（unusual）。A 错：Emma 问贵不贵，他说有点贵；B 错：新游戏到处都能买到。

q15.explanationZh: Emma 说那里的汉堡好极了，Jamie 回答“That’s true!”表示同意，所以两人都认为那里的食物很棒。C 错：Jamie 说音乐很吵，Emma 不同意；A 错：Jamie 觉得服务员从来没时间聊天。

q16.explanationZh: 女孩说妈妈工作到很晚，她得给妹妹 Annie 喂饭、洗澡，所以去不了聚会。A 错：男孩猜她不舒服，但不是这个原因；B 错：作业是她照顾完妹妹以后做的。

q17.explanationZh: 老师觉得 Danielle 选的题目没有足够的内容可写，想让她换一个题目（choose something else to write about）。A 错：老师没让她写长一点；B 错：老师给她多五天时间，能早点完成只是可以，不是要求。

q18.explanationZh: 男孩说旧书包太大，现在他用笔记本电脑，所以买了一个大小更合适的书包。A 错：皮的是他的旧书包；C 错：他说颜色可能太鲜艳了，这不是他喜欢的原因。

q19.explanationZh: 爸爸打电话是说明出了问题：女儿的哥哥（或弟弟）坐错了火车，爸爸要开车去接他，所以不能去学校接女儿，她得自己坐公交车回家。A 错：爸爸没法开车接她；C 错：问路的是她的哥哥（或弟弟），而且已经问到了。

q20.explanationZh: 她担心别人都比她滑得好，不想觉得尴尬，也就是担心自己滑得不好。A 错：天气会有风，浪很大，她觉得很好；C 错：朋友不来她说没问题。

q21.explanationZh: 奶奶说 Sofia 擅长击球类运动，比如曲棍球，Carlos 说她参加的其实是篮球队（basketball team）。E 错：hockey 只是奶奶的猜测。

q22.explanationZh: Aidan 买了一个球拍（racket），很喜欢用它，所以他在网球队（tennis）。B 错：他个子够高能打篮球，但篮球队满了。

q23.explanationZh: Tina 喜欢待在泳池里（in the pool），还赢了很多比赛，所以她在游泳队。C 错：奶奶常看到她骑自行车，但她不是骑行队的。

q24.explanationZh: 体育老师希望 Nick 加入曲棍球队，但他更喜欢排球（volleyball），而且打得很好。E 错：hockey 是老师的想法，不是他参加的队。

q25.explanationZh: Katrina 加入了一个叫“Fast wheels”的新队，她去哪儿都骑自行车，所以是自行车队（cycling）。B 错：她也想参加篮球队，但没有时间。

content.v: Test Two. There are five parts to the test. You will hear each piece twice. We will now stop for a moment. Please ask any questions now because you must NOT speak during the test.
Now look at the instructions for Part One.
For each question, choose the correct answer. Look at question one.
One. How much did the girl pay for her trainers?
Those trainers are really cool, and they look expensive. I love them!
Thanks, I got them in the sale. They were seventy-five pounds fifty but I got them for only forty-seven ninety-nine. I was lucky.
You were. My brother’s got some a bit like those, but they cost over fifty pounds, fifty-one seventy-five I think. Yours look much better.
Thanks, I’m glad you like them.
Two. Which picture does the boy choose for his grandmother?
Your photos are great, especially this one of the beach.
Thanks, I took them when I stayed with my grandmother last week. That picture of the castle’s my favourite. I’m keeping all of them on my phone so I can show people.
Those flowers are beautiful.
My grandmother loves them. I’ll print that photo for her. She wants to put it on her wall.
Three. What are they going to do first this afternoon?
What do we need to get now in the shopping centre?
I want to get that new board game. Will you play it with me later?
Of course. But hurry, we need to be back home for lunch. And Mum wants us to go on a bike ride after that.
OK, we’ll play the game after the bike ride.
Four. What did the girl put on the pizza yesterday?
Mum and Dad loved the pizza I made for us all yesterday!
Did it have lots of mushrooms and onion on it? That’s the kind I like.
We didn’t have any mushrooms left, so I used tomatoes with the onion instead.
Good idea. My mum puts tomatoes with mushrooms. She doesn’t really like onions, but I do.
Five. Which girl is the boy’s sister?
I think I saw your sister this morning, at the dentist’s. I love her long blonde hair.
Well, she’s got long hair but it’s dark. So, it wasn’t my sister you saw.
Oh, OK. I thought it was strange that the girl in the dentist wasn’t wearing glasses like your sister does.
Yeah, my sister can’t see well without them!
That is the end of Part One.
Now look at Part Two.
For each question, write the correct answer in the gap. Write one word or a number or a date or a time. Look at questions 6–10 now. You have ten seconds.
You will hear a boy called Jake leaving a message for a friend about coming to his house to play computer games.
Hi. I’m really glad you can come round to my house this weekend to play computer games. Come on Sunday, as I have to do all my homework on Saturday.
I need to give you my address. It’s number 51, Sherby Street. You spell that S-H-E-R-B-Y.
You can usually travel to my house by train, but the station nearest to my house is closed at the moment, so use the tram. It stops at the end of my road.
We want to have lots of time to play, so get here at quarter to two. I have to go out at half past four, so I’m afraid you’ll need to leave then, too.
Could you bring something with you? Remember you borrowed my gloves that day when it was really cold? Can I have them back, please? You can keep the hat I lent you – I’ve got lots of those.
One more thing. Mum says you should give your parents her phone number. It’s 05568 129437.
Right. See you soon!
That is the end of Part Two.
Now look at Part Three.
For each question, choose the correct answer. Look at questions 11–15 now. You have 20 seconds.
You will hear two friends, Emma and Jamie, planning a trip to a market.
Is your mum driving us to the market on Saturday, Emma?
She’s visiting my cousin. But we can go with Annie, who lives next door. She’s really nice.
Great! What time are we going?
We’ll come to your house at quarter to eleven, Jamie.
That’s quite late.
Well, I’ve got my piano lesson until quarter past ten. I won’t be ready to leave home before half past ten.
OK. Do you want to get a dress for the school dance at the market?
I’m borrowing my friend Katie’s actually, but I need to find a necklace and earrings to wear with it.
I want to buy a toy for my brother’s birthday.
The market’s great for old computer games too.
Yeah! They’re ones you can’t get in other places. You can get new ones anywhere.
Are they expensive?
A little.
We can have lunch at the Moon Café later.
They play very loud music.
Not really, Jamie! And the burgers are fantastic.
That’s true! But it’s a shame the waiters never have time to chat.
They’re always smiling!
That is the end of Part Three.
Now look at Part Four.
For each question, choose the correct answer.
Sixteen. You will hear two friends talking about a party. Why couldn’t the girl go to it?
Marco’s party on Saturday night was great. It’s a shame you missed it. Weren’t you feeling well or something?
Actually, Mum was working late so I had to give Annie her tea and a bath.
Your baby sister?
Yeah. But after that I didn’t just watch TV, I did my homework so then I was free on Sunday.
Seventeen. You will hear a teacher talking to a student called Danielle. What does he want Danielle to do?

About your project, Danielle. I’m not really sure there’s enough to write on the topic you’ve chosen, so I’d like you to choose something else to write about. I’m happy for you to have an extra five days to get it finished, although of course, if you’re able to do it earlier, then give it to me when it’s completed.
Eighteen. You will hear a boy talking to his friend about his new school bag. Why does he like his new bag?
Cool bag!
Maybe it’s too bright! But my old one was really big because of all my books. Now I use my laptop, so I got one which was a better size for that.
You cycle to school, don’t you?
Yeah. So it won’t be as heavy as my old leather one.
Well, nobody will miss that colour when you go past!
Nineteen. You will hear a father leaving a message for his daughter. Why is he phoning his daughter?

Hi! It’s Dad. Sorry, I can’t meet you from school this afternoon. Your brother somehow caught the wrong train to get to his friend’s house. He managed to get directions and finally arrived at his friend’s, but I’ve offered to drive there and bring him back.
You’ll have to get the bus home – hope you don’t mind. I’ll see you later.
Twenty. You will hear a girl talking about going to her first surfing lesson. How is she feeling about it?

It’s my first surfing lesson tomorrow. I’ve done some surfing already with my friend, but she’s not coming with me. That’s no problem, but what if everyone’s better than me – I don’t want to feel embarrassed. I’ve checked the weather forecast and it’s going to be windy, so there’ll be some lovely big waves to practise on.
That is the end of Part Four.
Now look at Part Five.
For each question, choose the correct answer. Look at questions 21–25 now. You have 15 seconds.
You will hear Carlos talking to his grandmother about the school sports teams he and his classmates are in. Which team is each person in?
Are there many sports teams at your school, Carlos?
Yes, Granny. I wanted to be in the cycling team, but there weren’t any places, so I joined the football team. It’s fun.
And your sister Sofia? She’s good at sports where you hit the ball, like hockey.
Yeah, but it’s the basketball team she plays for.
Oh. And what about your friend Aidan?
He’s bought a racket and loves using that. I was surprised, because he’s tall enough to play basketball, but the team is full! Do you know my neighbour, Tina?
The one I sometimes see riding her bicycle?
Yes. Well, she loves being in the pool. She wins lots of races.
That’s good. And she has a brother, doesn’t she?
Yeah. Nick. The sports teacher wanted him to join the hockey team, but he prefers volleyball! He’s really good at that.
And your friend Katrina?
She joined a new team called ‘Fast wheels’! It’s perfect for her because she goes everywhere by bike. She wanted to be in the basketball team too, but she doesn’t have time.
It’s great that you all do sports.
That is the end of Part Five.
You now have six minutes to write your answers on the answer sheet.
You have one more minute.
That is the end of the test.
